name: Harry Potter · Adult Wizards, 1991
description: In London in 1991, an unassuming pub leads to Diagon Alley. Robes, owls and wands have shops of their own while people wait for buses on the other side. Farther away, Hogsmeade shopkeepers are already counting on the September school trade.
title: Harry Potter · Adult Wizards, 1991

hp-start-traveller.name: Diagon Alley visitor
hp-start-traveller.description: You finished basic magical schooling and have arrived in London with a suitcase. The Leaky Cauldron’s keeper has set the room key on the counter.

hp-start-potions.name: Potion-ingredient buyer
hp-start-potions.description: You bring a list of ingredients to Diagon Alley. The price beside the last item has been crossed out.

hp-start-village.name: Hogsmeade lodger
hp-start-village.description: You have taken a room in Hogsmeade. From the inn you can see the road to the school. A hiring notice hangs at the door.

hp-start-trained-apothecary.name: Experienced potion maker
hp-start-trained-apothecary.description: Years mixing potions earned you some savings and a practiced hand. The supplier has placed a muddy bundle of roots on the counter for inspection.

hp-start-journeyman-wizard.name: Wizard returned from abroad
hp-start-journeyman-wizard.description: After years abroad, you return to Hogsmeade with money put aside and a set of well-practiced everyday spells. The old inn is open, under a new keeper.
